description: Unit test script for webkitpy layout test result writer, testing file writing behavior based on test failures and reference files.

classes.name: TestResultWriterTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing test result writing logic, including handling of failures and file outputs.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Helper method to simulate running a test with specified failures and files, and capturing written files.

methods.name: test_success
methods.description: Test case verifying that no files are written when there are no failures.

methods.name: test_reference_exists
methods.description: Test case verifying that reference files are correctly written when failures occur with existing reference files.

methods.name: test_reference_is_missing
methods.description: Test case verifying that no files are written when reference files are missing.

methods.name: test_baseline_name
methods.description: Test case verifying the correctness of the baseline_name function for different filename inputs.
